content_units: Best Pick for an Engineering Student
For your priorities—  battery life, CAD software, and portability  —the best overall choice is   Laptop A  .

It gives you the strongest balance of   student-friendly weight  ,   dedicated GPU for CAD/light gaming  , and   stays under your 1200 EUR budget  . Laptop B is more portable and likely better on battery, but its integrated graphics are the main weakness for CAD. Laptop C is the most powerful, but it breaks your budget and is the heaviest.
